summary: Parallel codex-critic instances share MEMORY.md and a fixed message path; index-lock retry cannot prevent lost or crossed writes.
deferral_rationale: Reconcile v1 (code-review r1) severity downgrade: the MEMORY.md read/modify/write race between same-agent parallel instances PRE-EXISTS the commit duty — uncommitted parallel memory writes race identically, and the round changes only whether the result is committed. The genuinely new exposure is bounded: a shared per-agent /tmp message-file path (worst case a wrong commit message) and a sibling index row transiently swept into a commit without its lesson file, which self-heals when the sibling commits its own pair. The plan-stage critic adjudicated composer parallelism (plan v3 §15, v1→v2 delta item 3: the index-lock retry-once clause) and APPROVEd; the committed disposition strictly reduces the #2015 permanent-loss exposure vs status quo. Hardening candidate for a follow-up (invocation-unique message path / serialized index update), not a round blocker.

But the roster is pre-existing state outside plan v3 §10's five-file scope (per-twin edits are §14 must-ask territory), the impact is bounded to 1 of 8 twins, and that twin's fallback is exactly today's status quo (no regression — it also composes its prompt file via Bash already). One-line follow-up: add Write to that roster, or sanction a temp-file-only Bash alternative in the recipe. Not a round blocker.

summary: The lint accepts the cross-reference anywhere before an unanchored heading, allowing structural drift to pass.
deferral_rationale: Reconcile v1 (code-review r1) severity downgrade: the code-behavior claims are accurate (substring heading probe at scripts/workflow_lint.py:15025; crossref accepted anywhere in text[:idx] at :15046) but the committed lens matches the critic-approved plan v3 D2 near-final text verbatim, including the v1→v2 tightening the plan critic actually demanded (region bounded at the next '## ' heading). The lens fires on every motivating #2150-class state — missing file/heading, each dropped token, token migrated out of the section, crossref deleted — all pinned by the tamper battery. The residual false-pass shapes (a fenced quote of the heading earlier in the file; the crossref migrated into a different pre-heading section) are narrow drift shapes shared with the #2326 sibling precedent; the Claude reviewer's Minor with the one-line line-anchored-regex fix (both siblings together, plus a quoted-heading tamper case) is the right disposition. Optional hardening, not a round blocker.
